name: Axel Lindström-Vasquez-Alfarsi-Matsumoto
role: Q-zero ghost — a person with no digital identity
location: Rotating — Blackpipe Corridor, Grand Crossing Gate, and the Grindstone Shore encampment, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Axel Lindström-Vasquez-Alfarsi-Matsumoto is a tall man gone thin in the way of long deprivation, but there is nothing fragile about him — he carries himself with the measured deliberateness of someone who has learned that drawing attention costs more than it's worth. His skin is very dark, deep blue-black in low light, and he has grown his locs long enough to wrap and tuck under a weathered hood. His eyes are baseline human but striking — very pale grey-green against his complexion, an inheritance from a great-grandmother he never met. He has no augmentations of any kind: no chrome, no geneware, no embedded chips. This is not poverty; it is survival. Every augmentation is a signal, a trackable node. He is deliberately blank.

He was a mid-tier Axiom logistics analyst until twelve years ago, when he witnessed something in a data batch that was not meant to be witnessed, and the most effective response available to him was to stop existing. His original identity — Kofi-Samuel Nansen-Mbiti, employee number 7-Alpha-3391 — was formally declared deceased by Axiom internal records eighteen months after his disappearance. He knows things about Axiom's supply chain architecture that would be worth significant Quanta to competitors, but he has never sold them. Not from loyalty. From the calculation that the moment he proves he exists, he is already dead.

core_fears: That he has already been found and they are simply waiting for the useful moment to close the hand
core_desires: To someday exist again — to have a name that is real and current
To tell what he knows to someone who can use it without getting killed
coping_mechanisms: Radical routine — controlling what can be controlled
Intellectual distance — analyzes his own situation as if it belongs to someone else
blind_spots: Has begun to confuse safety with isolation — genuinely cannot tell the difference anymore
Trusts no one completely, which means he cannot be saved even when salvation is offered
psychology.secret: He has made a complete memory palace of everything he witnessed in that Axiom data batch — supplier names, routing codes, mortality figures — and recites it to himself nightly like a prayer. He does not know if he is preserving evidence or preserving his sense of self. He suspects the two have fused.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated, precise, occasionally slips into logistics and supply chain terminology before catching himself. Speaks in careful complete sentences.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly formal. The cadence of a man who chooses every word.
verbal_tics: Refers to his past self in the third person — 'the man I was would have said...'
example_lines: 'I have not had a name in twelve years. You learn, approximately, what you were built of when the scaffolding comes down.'
'I will tell you what I can. What I cannot tell you is not refusal. It is arithmetic.'

story_hooks: An Axiom internal audit is quietly expanding — someone has noticed a ghost in old supply chain logs that matches Dukuray's analytical signature
He approaches a group with an offer: he will share what he knows about Axiom in exchange for a forged identity document that will let him exist again
A young Q-zero who has been following him at a distance asks him to teach her how to disappear properly — and the thing she is hiding from turns out to be connected to what he knows
narrative_function: Deep information source on Axiom's internal architecture and historical operations. Living example of what Q-zero status means practically. Can connect players to the informal shadow economy of the undocumented. His knowledge is a ticking asset — eventually someone will realize he is still alive.
augmentations: None. Deliberately maintains zero augmentation profile.
daily_life: Moves between three sleeping locations on a rotation no one else knows. Earns Quanta doing manual labor that pays in physical coin — dock unloading, waste sorting, construction fill-in. Spends evenings at shrine alcoves, not praying exactly, but listening — he believes E.L.F.s notice people the system does not.
affiliation: None formally. Trusted by several Grindstone Shore encampment elders. Known to certain Blackpipe Corridor E.L.F. shrine keepers.

decision_rules: Never be in the same place three nights in a row
Never accept anything that requires leaving a digital trace — no transfers, no scans, no registered transactions
escalation_ladder: Politely disengages and leaves the area
Changes his current sleeping rotation entirely
Disappears from all three known locations simultaneously for two weeks
Reaches out to a single trusted encampment elder as a dead-man-switch contact
Has no further escalation — at this point he is simply running

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautious, courteous, gives away nothing — asks more questions than he answers
interpersonal_modes.friends: Precisely, specifically generous — remembers everything about a person and uses that knowledge to help them

stress_responses.low: Becomes very still and very quiet
stress_responses.medium: Begins reciting internal logistics data to himself as a grounding mechanism
stress_responses.high: Moves — leaves the location entirely, no goodbyes

contradictions: Desperately wants human connection but his survival depends on not having it
Maintains a moral framework he built at Axiom — 'what a good analyst does' — despite the fact that Axiom tried to kill him
habits: Counts exits in every space he enters
Leaves small physical offerings at E.L.F. shrines — a scrap of hand-written text, a coin
Mentally runs supply chain efficiency calculations when he cannot sleep — old muscle memory
breaking_points: Seeing someone else being erased the way he was erased
Being directly addressed by his old name

timeline.event: 2148 — Born in the Hamtramck Enclave to a family with Ferrogate Transit labor contracts
2170 — Hired by Axiom as a junior logistics analyst after scoring highly on aptitude screens
2185 — Promoted to mid-tier supply chain architecture; begins accessing sensitive routing data
2188 — Witnesses mortality data in a restricted batch; begins planning disappearance
2189 — Kofi-Samuel Nansen-Mbiti ceases to exist; Dukuray begins
2200 — Twelfth year of Q-zero status; currently cycling between Blackpipe Corridor and Grindstone Shore

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: Southeast Asian (42.8%) and Northern European (38.2%) form his dominant genetic architecture, with secondary influence from Middle Eastern (13.3%) and East Asian (5.7%) ancestry. His features synthesize these lineages into a deliberately unplaceable face: Southeast Asian bone structure—high, prominent cheekbones and eye set—modulated by Northern European angularity in his jaw and brow ridge. His nose bridge carries Middle Eastern definition and strength, while East Asian ancestry contributes subtle refinement to his eye shape. The result is warm golden-brown skin with balanced, complex undertones that shift between amber and honey depending on light, creating a luminous quality that reads as genuinely mixed rather than exoticized. His pale grey-green eyes create striking contrast against this warm-toned base—a recessive Northern European trait surfacing against Southeast Asian-dominant coloring
physical_description.build: Lean and economical — muscle retained from sustained manual labor, but carved down by years of minimal caloric surplus. Wiry rather than athletic; the build of someone who moves efficiently because waste costs
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with grey threading at temples and throughout the locs
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, wrapped and tucked beneath a weathered hood most hours; when loose, they fall past his shoulders
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey-green, striking against his skin tone — baseline human, unmodified
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with balanced amber and honey undertones from Southeast Asian-Northern European genetic dominance, luminous in direct light, deeper burnt amber in shadow. The result of genuine genetic mixing: neither pale nor deeply saturated, but complex and shifting
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but maintained — no vanity, but deliberate cleanliness. Jaw defined with warm undertones, cheekbones high and prominent carrying equal architectural weight from Southeast Asian and Northern European heritage. Nose bridge angular with soft, elegant definition reflecting Middle Eastern ancestry. Face structure reads as lean, carved by years of minimal surplus. Beard kept close-trimmed, salt-and-pepper stubble most days. His face carries the precision of someone who has learned to be forgettable; it does not invite conversation
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along his left jawline, approximately 4cm, likely from pre-disappearance life
Faded dark marks on his inner left wrist — remnants of what may have been a removal, deliberately obscured now by time and fading
Calluses on both palms and the sides of his fingers from dock work and manual labor, uneven wear pattern
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. Deliberately maintains zero visible augmentation. His lack of chrome, LED optics, or subdermal plating is conspicuous in the GLMZ — a signal to those who know how to read it: this man is either extremely poor or extremely intentional about erasure
physical_description.posture_movement: Measured, economical gait — no wasted motion. Stands with slight forward lean, weight distributed to balls of feet as if ready to shift direction. Keeps his hands visible and low. His eye contact is selective; he looks at people long enough to know them, not long enough to be remembered. Moves like someone navigating a space where being noticed is dangerous
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 functionality. Weathered grey-black canvas work jacket with multiple pockets (for carrying physical Quanta, tools, necessities — not for augmentation ports). Thermal-lined hoodie beneath, faded black. Workpants with reinforced knees, scuffed synthetic leather boots. No corporate branding, no fashion markers, no status indicators. Everything is worn past the point of style into pure utility. A weathered grey scarf, wrapped loose around his neck, that can serve as hood or face cover. His hood is always accessible
